# Shadekin
Fluffy folks with a deep connection to The Dark — a parallel space they can occasionally slip into.
## Ability Differences
- Need no air to survive. - Can Shadeskip — a short-range blink. - Can travel to and from The Dark at will, dimming nearby lights while there. - When too low on energy, they may fall into a powerful sleep until they recover. - Can "speak" via Empathy that only other Shadekin can understand. - Less cold damage, slightly more heat damage. - Near no cellular damage. - More bloodloss and radiation damage.
## Physical Differences
- Very large and brightly colored eyes with no pupils. - Sees the world through their eyes' tint. - Very large ears, very fluffy build. - Can be Male, Female, or Unsexed. - Can be 18-300 years old.
## The Anomaly (Awakened Shadekin)
Most Shadekin walk the station as ordinary crew — "blackeyes", cut off from The Dark and without powers. A rare few awaken as an **Anomaly**: a Shadekin who spawns within The Dark hideout with their full gift.
- **Phase Shift** — slip into The Dark to walk unseen and pass through walls. Costs energy, and bright light makes it harder or impossible. - **Darkvision** — toggle to see in the dark. - **Energy & Light** — energy regenerates in darkness and drains in light. Watch the Energy / Light Exposure alert. - **The Dark** — travel between the station and the hideout through dark portals. - **Rest** — sleep to recover energy faster. On the brink of death, an Anomaly is dragged back into The Dark to rejuvenate.
Anomalies are crew-aligned but not legally crew. See the **Anomaly SOP** (under Science) for conduct rules.
